en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Washa, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, said,
‘I heard him<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The skilfulness of a man is a door (way) to his earnings (for living)’.
en.sarwar: 12. Al-Husayn from Muhammad has narrated from Mu’alla’ ibn Muhammad from af-Washsha’ who has said the foiiowing: “I once heard him (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ‘The skillfulness of a man is for his earning a living.’”
